_doc: Which venues a US-resident account can actually execute on. executable_for_us is the fact the engine acts on; adapter says whether this repo can price the venue at all; state_restrictions is a list of two-letter states where the venue itself blocks the product (empty = none known; re-verify by hand, it is not enforced anywhere but executable_venues(home_state=...)). Every row needs verified (ISO date the source was last read) and source (URL); stale_verification() flags rows older than 30 days so the table is re-read before every live week.

kalshi.note: CFTC-designated contract market (DCM); sports event contracts offered to US residents. Some states have contested sports contracts in 2025-26; list them in state_restrictions once verified.

robinhood.note: Robinhood Derivatives LLC (CFTC-registered FCM) routes event contracts to KalshiEX, Rothera and CDNA; no order API, hedges are executed by hand from the alert.

sources: gamma-api.polymarket.com /events restricted=true on every NFL event (tests/fixtures/polymarket_events_nfl.json, captured 2026-09-18)
polymarket.note: Global CLOB. The CFTC order of 2022-01-03 (Blockratize Inc. d/b/a Polymarket) and the Terms of Use bar US persons from trading; Gamma marks these markets restricted=true. Prices are still useful as a fair-value reference, so the adapter stays.

polymarket_us.note: CFTC-regulated separate product (QCEX DCM). Executable for US persons but this repo has no adapter for it yet, so it never appears in a scan.
